name: cognitive-mirror
description: Second Brain PKM — local-first self-managing knowledge graph with interactive (MCP) and autonomous (API daemon) reasoning paths.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n graph,ingest,daemon,mcp -c blue,green,magenta,cyan "pnpm --filter @cm/graph-core dev" "pnpm --filter @cm/ingestion dev" "pnpm --filter @cm/reasoning-daemon dev" "pnpm --filter @cm/mcp-server dev"
scripts.reset: pnpm --filter @cm/graph-core reset && rm -f .data/queue.sqlite .data/queue.sqlite-shm .data/queue.sqlite-wal && echo 'fresh start — graph + queue cleared'
